spell.name: Ember Bolt
spell.description: A common fire cantrip, quick enough to trust in bad situations.

spell.name: Frost Lance
spell.description: A mage-only spear of cold light that punches through ordinary defenses.

spell.name: Sunfire Burst
spell.description: A codex-taught bloom of bright fire, controlled enough to be scholarship and violence at once.

spell.name: Storm Chain
spell.description: A codex-only mage spell that leaps from one focus point to the next in white-green lightning.

spell.name: Moonfire Arc
spell.description: A high-order mage spell that bends moonfire into a clean, punishing arc.

spell.name: Arcane Ward
spell.description: A shared starter ward that lifts a thin wall of force around you.

spell.name: Veil Barrier
spell.description: A spellbook ward that catches impact in layered silver veils.

spell.name: Stone Skin
spell.description: A mage-only ward that layers stone memory over skin and robe.

spell.name: Ember Guard
spell.description: A warrior charm that hardens resolve into heat-bright armor for the next rush.

spell.name: Starless Aegis
spell.description: A forbidden ward copied from citadel plates, strong enough to make darkness strike itself first.

spell.name: Minor Mend
spell.description: A modest healing charm, useful but weaker than a proper healing tonic.

spell.name: Steady Pulse
spell.description: A practical mender's spell that slows panic, steadies breath, and closes the worst small wounds.

spell.name: Root Mend
spell.description: A field charm learned from Thornwild notes, coaxing stubborn flesh to knit like living bark.

spell.name: Oasis Balm
spell.description: A Vel'rasha healing spell that cools the skin like spring water and pulls pain out by degrees.

spell.name: Moonlit Restoration
spell.description: A mage-grade restoration that sets silver light under the ribs and asks the body to remember wholeness.

spell.name: Herbal Cleanse
spell.description: A simple cleansing charm that wakes the body's own resistance before venom settles in.

spell.name: Purify Blood
spell.description: A clean pulse of magic that breaks venom before it can bite deeper.

spell.name: Venom Break
spell.description: A tougher cure spell that cracks poison apart and returns a little strength to the blood.

spell.name: Desert Antivenom
spell.description: A precise Vel'rasha formula for scorpion venom, snakebite, and other inconvenient chemistry.

spell.name: Moon Purge
spell.description: A silver purge that burns poison out through moonlit sweat and leaves the air smelling of rain.

spell.name: Flash
spell.description: A sharp burst of white light that blinds one foe long enough to spoil its next attack.

spell.name: Snare Glare
spell.description: A hard stare turned magical, catching a foe's next movement in invisible brambles.

spell.name: Hourglass Stutter
spell.description: A timing spell that makes a foe lose the heartbeat it needed to strike.

spell.name: Void Flash
spell.description: A black-white pulse that interrupts a foe's sense of time long enough to spoil two attacks.

spell.name: Gravity Lull
spell.description: A moon-archive control spell that makes the air around a foe suddenly remember how heavy it is.

spell.name: Shadow Palm
spell.description: A rogue charm that cools the fingers and blurs the small movements honest eyes are trained to catch.

spell.name: Lock Whisper
spell.description: A rogue charm that lets old tumblers answer in tiny clicks before the pick fully turns.

spell.name: Gutter Grace
spell.description: A streetwise rogue spell that keeps hands light, sleeves quiet, and witnesses helpfully uncertain.

spell.name: Mirage Step
spell.description: A rogue spell that leaves the hand half a pace behind where witnesses think it should be.

spell.name: Quietus Glimmer
spell.description: A rogue manuscript spell that dims intent itself, letting careful hands move through a hush of false innocence.

spell.name: Battle Focus
spell.description: A warrior-only breath cadence that turns discipline into sharper strikes.

spell.name: Shieldbreaker Chant
spell.description: A clipped warrior chant that teaches each strike to look for the weak point in a guard.

spell.name: Titan Surge
spell.description: A warrior battle chant that briefly fills the arms with giant strength.

spell.name: Colossus Rhythm
spell.description: An Emberdeep marching cadence that makes heavy strikes land with forge-hammer certainty.

spell.name: Final Oath
spell.description: A last-gate warrior oath that turns resolve into brutal, focused force for a few decisive blows.
